meta.title: A11oy Public Capability Manifest
meta.scope: Public and investor-facing capability status for the Replit export aligned to GitHub. Status values are conservative and exclude unverified customer, revenue, compliance, or live-execution claims.

capabilities.evidence: A11oy surfaces expose the governed workflow model and keep consequential actions behind policy and approval gates. Mutating high-risk execution remains blocked until Phase 2 workcell approval paths are completed.
capabilities.test_coverage: Covered by existing UI/build gates; service-level expansion required before production execution.

capabilities.evidence: Signal mesh, action rail, and operator control surfaces are present in the investor UI with seeded operational data and cross-domain event correlation views.
capabilities.test_coverage: UI smoke/build checks; live connector verification remains separate.

capabilities.evidence: Proof ledger surfaces show source, confidence, policy result, approval state, and audit context for demo recommendations. Hash-linked production proof persistence remains gated by deployment configuration.
capabilities.test_coverage: Existing proof doctrine and UI proof surfaces; route-level audit tests required before production certification.

capabilities.evidence: Policy posture is explicit: consequential AI action requires source/provenance, confidence, approval state, policy result, and failure handling. Finance and high-risk execution remain advisory or blocked by default.
capabilities.test_coverage: Policy gate tests exist across packages; full route-by-route enforcement evidence tracked separately.

capabilities.evidence: Phase 1 operator surfaces and read-side API are present. Live AI workcell execution and durable approval workflows are still in Phase 2 scope.
capabilities.test_coverage: UI coverage only until service orchestration is promoted.

capabilities.evidence: Corporate, investor, trust, product-readiness, and A11oy pages are present with verified current screenshots and demo-mode posture.
capabilities.test_coverage: Vite build and visual proof capture scripts available.

capabilities.evidence: Canonical source-of-truth records 385 API route files as of 2026-04-26, with route groups and commands documented for reproduction.
capabilities.test_coverage: CI includes lint, typecheck, test, build, and security workflows; DATABASE_URL-dependent checks require environment configuration.

capabilities.evidence: Public docs consistently cite an 11-role RBAC model. Trust status treats live probes and manifest evidence separately so public copy does not overclaim certification.
capabilities.test_coverage: Auth and tenant isolation tests exist; production evidence requires configured auth and database services.

capabilities.evidence: Source-of-truth records 24 GitHub Actions workflows covering CI, CodeQL, dependency review, security scans, build, E2E, Lighthouse, README QA, and one archived manual-only workflow.
capabilities.test_coverage: Workflow definitions are present locally; GitHub status depends on pushed branch and repository secrets.

capabilities.evidence: The current audit baseline records 15 registered deployable artifacts, 146 packages/libraries, 182 schema files, 385 API route files, 730 provisioned PostgreSQL tables, and 275 declared environment variables.
capabilities.test_coverage: scripts/audit/validate-source-of-truth.js

capabilities.evidence: TENAX is listed as an active domain pack and retains the /sentra route slug. Cyber command views are present for demo and evaluation workflows.
capabilities.test_coverage: Artifact build and API route tests where configured.

capabilities.evidence: PARAGON supersedes Aegis as the display direction while legacy Aegis artifact routes remain available. Public copy avoids claiming operational deployment.
capabilities.test_coverage: Artifact and UI checks where configured.

capabilities.evidence: SEXTANT/Vessels is an active domain pack with seeded fleet and voyage workflows. Live AIS or sanctions enrichment requires configured external providers.
capabilities.test_coverage: UI and seed coverage; live-provider tests blocked until credentials are configured.

capabilities.evidence: DOMAINE/Terra is active with real-estate workflows and partial seed coverage. Mapping and external enrichment are provider-gated.
capabilities.test_coverage: UI and seed coverage; provider-backed tests require configured environment.

capabilities.evidence: Counsel is an active legal matter command surface. PRISM Counsel remains archived and is not represented as an active product.
capabilities.test_coverage: Artifact checks and demo data; production legal integrations require customer configuration.

capabilities.evidence: Carlota Jo remains an active private advisory domain pack with demo-safe client portal surfaces. Public copy avoids unverified customer or revenue claims.
capabilities.test_coverage: Artifact UI/build checks where configured.

capabilities.evidence: LUMINA supersedes Pulse in display naming while the /pulse slug remains. Executive briefing UI is present; live AI and delivery providers are environment-gated.
capabilities.test_coverage: UI checks; live briefing delivery tests require configured AI and email providers.

capabilities.evidence: FORGE/Command portal surfaces are registered and active as a cross-domain command experience. Full live aggregation remains dependent on production service wiring.
capabilities.test_coverage: Artifact UI/build checks where configured.

capabilities.evidence: APEX is the sole registered mobile artifact. Public copy should present mobile as prototype-stage until release signing, stores, and push credentials are configured.
capabilities.test_coverage: Mobile artifact checks where available.

capabilities.evidence: The canonical baseline records 95 package entries and 51 shared library entries, for 146 packages/libraries total.
capabilities.test_coverage: Monorepo lint/typecheck/test/build scripts and per-package checks where configured.
